summary: GridAI Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, reporting that on October 1, 2026 it entered a Second Amended and Restated Secured Convertible Note with Pronghorn Resources, LLC, adding a third loan of $536,000 and bringing the aggregate principal to $3,500,000, following a $2,000,000 original loan and $964,000 second loan. A Second Amendment to Security Agreement updated the collateral definition. The registrant is the lender/issuer, not an acquirer or target; no board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium or closing date is stated. Watch the borrower's repayment or conversion and any share overhang.
